Whilst Dr Bodalia and Dr Kaur who I would give 5 stars are very thorough it is the actual process of obtaining an appointment and also some of the reception staffs attitudes who let this surgery down .
Once getting through on the phone no one tells you the process of waiting up to 48 hours for an appointment which is a waste of time . I’ve been told today that I should know the process of phoning at 8am to book a same day appt when I was under the impression that it was an online booking system and was spoken to like I’m in the wrong which I don’t appreciate . The attitude from staff is rude to patients who are unwell . On previous occasions when  both my Daughter and I have had appts actually booked they had  been booked in incorrectly and Drs calling us when we made it clear we were not available . Staff then tried to blame us but we had text messages of the correct times booked as proof . When I said I’d complain I was told to do so via e-consult , no discussion to the relevant person. I was so annoyed and disappointed I hung up .
I feel I have no alternative but to now find an alternative GP surgery .",null,[0,239]]]],[],[null,null,null,["https://www.google.com/maps/reviews/data=!4m8!14m7!1m6!2m5!1sCi9DQUlRQUNvZENodHljRjlvT25OWE1sVk5RVjlwY1ZFME1FaHdkVTFYUlRGVmQyYxAB!2m1!1s0x0:0xc7e9fb95bab480f6!3m1!1s2@1:CAIQACodChtycF9oOnNXMlVNQV9pcVE0MEhwdU1XRTFVd2c%7C%7C?hl=en"],["https://www.google.com/local/content/rap/report?postId=Ci9DQUlRQUNvZENodHljRjlvT25OWE1sVk5RVjlwY1ZFME1FaHdkVTFYUlRGVmQyYxAB&t=1&--nHKgswZGMzM1lSTllrVQ&wv=1&d=286732320",null,null,"0ahUKEwiZ7_jgwrOTAxXJeIQGHev3J5gQoykIBCgB"],null,[null,[[1,0]]]],"0ahUKEwiZ7_jgwrOTAxXJeIQGHev3J5gQ0pMFCAIoAA"],null,"CAESY0NBRVFBUnBFUTJwRlNVRlNTWEJEWjI5QlVEY3lSMDV0UVZreGNsOWZSV2hEVUdGU2RITjRaa0pwUzNNMmMzbERiMEZCUVVGQlIyZHVPVEpSVVVOWk1sbENhbGR6V1VGRFNVRQ=="],[["Ci9DQUlRQUNvZENodHljRjlvT2pCQlpYSnhZbmxRY0Y4MWJteHpiSFIzVWsxRWFsRRAB",["0x0:0xc7e9fb95bab480f6",null,1770998315502902,1770998315502902,[null,null,["https://www.google.com/maps/contrib/103745252910277378154/reviews?hl=en"],null,null,["Phil Macdonald","https://lh3.googleusercontent.com/a-/ALV-UjXC-oAkzrFlvgPdggc_y6ugizs12NwPm0XQT7gKtTvOaktfub4i=s120-c-rp-mo-br100",["https://www.google.com/maps/contrib/103745252910277378154?hl=en"],"103745252910277378154",null,3,0,null,[0,2,1],0,["3 reviews",null,null,null,null,[null,"0ahUKEwiZ7_jgwrOTAxXJeIQGHev3J5gQ7LoGCAYoAA"]]]],null,"a month ago",null,null,null,null,null,null,["Google","https://www.gstatic.com/images/branding/product/1x/googleg_48dp.png",null,null,5],null,1],[[5],null,null,null,null,null,null,null,null,null,null,null,null,null,["en"],[["Needed to see a doctor yesterday.
